import html # Predefined HTML structure for blog posts. It uses `{title}` and `{body}` # placeholders that will be replaced by the sanitized headline and content. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def format_blog_entry(headline: str, content: str) -> str: """ Prepare a user‑submitted blog entry for secure web display. Parameters ---------- headline : str The main heading or subject of the blog post. content : str The complete textual content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and HTML‑formatted blog post, ready for secure presentation on the webpage. Raises ------ TypeError If either `headline` or `content` is not a string. """ # Validate input types if not isinstance(headline, str): raise TypeError("headline must be a string") if not isinstance(content, str): raise TypeError("content must be a string") # 1. Escape all HTML special characters to prevent XSS safe_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_content = html.escape(content, quote=True) # 2. Replace placeholders in the template formatted = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_headline, body=safe_content) # 3. Return the final HTML snippet return formatted.strip()
